question: The Commission wants to earmark up to EUR 100 billion for Ukraine in the 2028-2034 budget, while itself admitting that the country’s future needs cannot be predicted. Even so, it is requesting a huge margin for further expenditure in advance. This EUR 100 billion is in addition to the Global Europe instrument, which is already generous in its own right. 1.
Why is the Commission requesting up to EUR 100 billion when it itself admits that it cannot predict Ukraine’s needs?
What is preventing the Commission from proposing a specific amount only once it is able to say what the money will be spent on?
In the Commission’s view, is there a ceiling on support for Ukraine, or should every further bill be paid regardless of the amount?
